calculate_mAP: calculate the mean average precision from a similarity matrix and a relevancy matrix
run_mAP_evaluation: run the mAP evaluation on cross-modal retrieval results using a similarity and relevancy matrix
test_calculate_mAP: test the calculate_mAP function with a sample similarity matrix and ground truth relevancy matrix
refactor_calculate_mAP: refactor the calculate_mAP function to support batched input matrices for faster evaluation
summarize_calculate_mAP: summarize the calculate_mAP function which computes mean average precision for cross-modal retrieval tasks
